notes: The author proposes replacing direct work with the very large Γ_K groups by their inverse-limit presentation through groups attached to affine models, especially elementary varieties or profinite K(π,1) models. He then considers strengthening the initial conjecture by requiring an exterior map of the script-E extensions to respect the model filtrations, in addition to the anabelian hypothesis and compatibility over Γ_Q. The concluding paragraph, beginning Nous allons, remains unfinished after et. This is a discussion of possible conjectural conditions, not a proof. The symbol lim has a left arrow below it; H’s expanded and underlined limite is not what is written. The inserted ext is attached after hom. Prendre is live and retraced: no distinct recoverable underlying cancelled word or independent cancellation stroke can be established, so none is invented. The source has no separately transcribed deletion, no diagram, and no display; its mathematics is inline. Both E letters are rounded script forms, matching the supplied extension notation. All four C marks resolve on viewed crops: suppose, allons, =, tels. The literal qu’elle est and tels are retained without grammatical correction. Both quote marks around filtrations modéliques are paired ticks, not guillemets. All three hom occurrences and the inserted ext are dotless. Hyp. and the faint t.f. punctuation remain as in C; no decisive absence of a t.f. stop is visible. No author page number is visible. Thin foliation 45 is at bottom left and is a margin item. All eligible numbers, additions, words disputed between C/H, and resolved C doubts are covered by coherent audit readings. No mathematical check was undertaken.
